### Modeling God's Message
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-march-27-2025.html
Passage: Hosea 1:2
Points:
- God directed Hosea to enter a scandalous marriage to physically embody a divine message before Israel.
- Facing public mockery and gossip, Hosea chose faithful obedience over personal comfort and social reputation.
- His heartbreak and steadfast commitment illustrated God's unwavering love toward a spiritually adulterous people.
- Living out God's calling often brings misunderstanding and requires both perseverance and a tender heart.

### Read the Bible: 2 Kings 9, 1 Timothy 6, Hosea 1, and Psalm 119:73–96
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/2-kings-9-1-timothy-6-hosea-1-psalm-11973-96/
Passage: Hosea 1:1-11
Points:
- Hosea reveals a God passionately moved by the unfaithfulness and spiritual drift of His covenant people.
- Hosea’s marriage to Gomer served as an explicit illustration of the nation's wholesale departure from Yahweh.
- The children's prophetic names signified imminent punishment, lost compassion, and national rejection.
- Despite the declarations of doom, the chapter ends with an unexpected promise of future restoration and divine adoption.
